body:
## Outcome and current status

The consumer launch shape is locked, but detailed space rules and the first agentic jobs still need bounded decisions. Create one finite release matrix so implementation does not move the finish line.

Part of #817. This is a planning/coordination deliverable. No delivery milestone label is earned merely by filing it.

## Scope and entry points

docs/specs/argus-execution-board.md; docs/specs/cuadrao-master-plan.md §§A4, B2, B9; docs/specs/argus-decision-log.md

Docs and scope reconciliation only. Do not change APIs, schemas, model instructions or feature availability. Product decisions remain with the founder.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Record personal/household first-release journeys and distinguish required TestFlight behavior from public-launch additions.
- [ ] Record the remaining space-model decisions for founder approval. Do not treat proposed business roles or retention as already approved.
- [ ] Name the first Cuadrao chat jobs and receipt capabilities to include. Record whether voice is included; no silent addition or removal of an approved capability.
- [ ] Record advanced Profile exclusions and preserve their development designs and later backlog.
- [ ] Keep Business/fiscal work, broad Liquid Glass adoption and Gmail outside this consumer checklist unless the founder explicitly changes scope. Keep Plaid as an approved direction without making production partner approval a blocker.
- [ ] Give each launch item an owner role, issue, acceptance journey and required environment. Record decisions and reconcile the board through its normal review process.

- [ ] Answer the five customer-work questions in #817 for every included journey. Record the manual baseline, work removed, relevant measures, acceptance target and evidence owner. Keep correctness and authorization mandatory.
- [ ] Link the approved reuse direction in PR #835. Extend existing Render Workflows; preserve reusable LangGraph and memory foundations for #826. Distinguish reuse, unfinished connection work, conditional tools and retirement candidates.

- [ ] Record the locked LangGraph + existing Mem0/pgvector + scoped on-demand context + Render Workflows stack. Framework selection is settled; define bounded jobs, first-release memory/voice availability and acceptance rather than reopen a vendor bakeoff.

## Dependencies and parallel work

Can proceed with read-only security, configuration and privacy preparation. It is the completion prerequisite for final release scope, not a freeze on existing approved fixes.

No native completion prerequisite. This scope record can start now. Existing linked issues keep their own acceptance and approval boundaries.

## Verification and closure

Use the approved scope in #817. Before a completion claim, record the original/current integration SHAs, PR head, relevant API/build identity, environment and runtime mode. Retain durable evidence for happy path, interruption/recovery, authorization and relaunch where relevant. Use focused deterministic checks and the real affected journey; document non-applicable checks instead of inventing passes. Physical journeys use the shared Mac/device scheduler.

Close with the accepted document/audit and named evidence. Activation is not applicable to this issue itself.

Any implementation requires its bounded assignment and approved contracts. Preserve default-off gates until authorized. Plan rollback at the changed owner; schema changes require backup and forward-recovery or rollback evidence before hosted execution. No merge, deployment, hosted mutation or paid provider run is authorized by this issue.

## October 4 alignment

Founder-approved planning alignment adds reuse, conversation-continuity and customer-outcome acceptance. [PR #835](https://github.com/lagarcess/argus/pull/835) carries the matching canonical documentation and remains unmerged at this edit. Existing assignments, implementation gates, labels and completion evidence remain unchanged. This edit does not claim live services or authorize paid runs, hosted changes or deployment.

## Planning evidence

Reviewed 2026-10-04 CT against integration `76b6afcb4080c6e639e8c50bdabf51621d862190`, the current execution board, master plan and open issue inventory. This is repository/GitHub planning, not a new runtime acceptance result. Deployed API/web/workflow SHAs and live runtime mode are omitted because no hosted inspection was performed. Revalidate specific gaps at assignment time.

## October 4 feedback disposition

The recurrence/category/forecast audit is recorded in #822, #823 and #824. Existing expectation scheduling and deterministic cash projection are reusable foundations; polished previews are not connected evidence.

Founder clarification is settled: recurring setup prepares expected payments and requires confirmation when paid. A date never records an actual transaction by itself.

The founder subsequently approved the transaction-to-recurring shortcut, rolling 30-day Home window, confirmed pattern suggestions, explicit past/future category corrections, revised gestures and schedule-based scenarios. Bound their contracts and sequence against the already-approved upcoming-commitment journey. Statistical forecasting libraries and vendor changes are not added launch prerequisites. Evaluate the existing lookforward experience with users rather than silently expanding or removing it.

Onboarding discovery, copy and recovery design can continue now; final space-dependent wiring and acceptance follow the shared contracts. Prioritize the connected schedule/category loop because it feeds Home, Plan, reminders and assistant context together.

## Founder lock, October 4 follow-up

Approved direction for scope and sequencing. Implement independently from Cuadrao requirements, existing contracts and tests; do not copy or mechanically rewrite outside source code; build each behavior from Cuadrao's own design intent. [PR #835](https://github.com/lagarcess/argus/pull/835) records the canonical behavior and design updates and remains unmerged at this edit.

Recurring items prepare expected payments/income and require confirmation or explicit linking when paid/received. A due date never posts money. Pattern suggestions follow usable manual recurring setup. The category, gesture and schedule-based scenario proposals above are now approved direction; detailed contracts and release inclusion still use #818/#826. Statistical forecasting remains optional evaluation, not a newly selected library or launch gate. No app code, hosted service, release flag or acceptance status changed.
